title: Wedjat eye-first deepening: can modern D011-D016 reconstruct full D010 better than unrelated hieroglyphs?
research_question: Ignoring the 1/2..1/64 values, do the six modern standardized D011-D016 eye-part glyphs collectively have specific compositional affinity to the full Wedjat glyph D010 beyond unrelated Egyptian hieroglyphs?

method.translation: All placements that keep the candidate inside the D010 bounding box.
method.single_glyph_fit: Choose scale and translation maximizing F1 overlap against D010.
method.six_glyph_score: Union the six independently best-aligned masks and calculate F1, recall and precision against D010.
method.control_fairness: Every unrelated glyph receives the identical alignment search before random six-glyph sets are sampled.

full_block_control.interpretation: No sampled six-glyph set from the full unrelated block reached the D011-D016 union score.

gardiner_D_class_hard_control.interpretation: Even against the harder same-Gardiner-D body-part class, D011-D016 are unusually good as a six-member reconstruction set, although rare unrelated D-class sets can score higher.

important_asymmetry.finding: Removing D015 improves the union F1 from 0.53068 to 0.55418.
important_asymmetry.meaning: The six standardized signs are not a literal exact jigsaw tiling of D010. D015 supplies only 58 target pixels unique relative to the other five under this fit while introducing substantial nonmatching shape. The positive set-level signal therefore must not be described as exact reconstruction.

relation_to_previous_results.synthesis: The useful modern-eye signal is compositional specificity, not repeated halving or proportional encoding of 1/2..1/64.

highest_admissible_claim: In the modern standardized Gardiner/Unicode rendering, D011-D016 as a six-member set have statistically unusual compositional affinity to the full Wedjat D010 glyph under a constrained scale-and-translation overlap test. The result survives 100,000 full-block random sets and a harder 100,000-set Gardiner-D-class control. However the union covers only about 52% of D010 and is not an exact six-piece tiling; D015 even worsens aggregate F1 under this simple registration. This demonstrates modern sign-family coherence, not ancient CSM derivation, fraction encoding, binary intent, or a historical six-piece puzzle.

new_eye_first_gate.question: On dated ancient witnesses, does each CSM sign align more specifically to its proposed Wedjat eye substructure than to same-document stroke/complexity-matched controls, and does that affinity appear early or emerge later?
required: Fraction labels frozen independently of visual fit.
No post-hoc mirroring or part reassignment.
Chronological holdout to distinguish primordial derivation from later secondary association.
